subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the documentation redirects are restored and the predecessor stack is accepted, should the exact-head qa-matrix package and lockfile-importer deletion be authorized?
rationale: Repository dependency-graph policy requires an admin or security authorization for this intentional package removal, and automation cannot decide whether the temporary compatibility surface may now be retired.

options.title: Authorize After Repair
options.body: Restore both public-route redirects, verify the stacked base, then authorize the exact-head package and lockfile deletion.

options.title: Retain Compatibility Surface
options.body: Keep the temporary qa-matrix package and runtime facade until a later explicitly versioned cleanup.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Defer this PR if the predecessor workflow and scenario-ownership changes are not going to land in their current form.

recommendation.title: Authorize After Repair
recommendation.body: Restore both public-route redirects, verify the stacked base, then authorize the exact-head package and lockfile deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the consolidation stack and can coordinate the required independent admin or security authorization after the repair.
